WaxTablet native sphere-module assembly
Author/depositor: Harley Cameron

Apache License, Version 2.0 applies to the native code and assembly documentation
in this target repository. Original applicable source notices are retained.
The preserved sphere-model code originated in the WaxTablet sphere benchmark
0.1.0 (https://zenodo.org/records/23261883).

Linked repositories retain their own source provenance and applicable notices;
the presence of a metadata identity or gitlink does not relicense their content.
The native modules implement bounded portable primitives, not reconstructed
upstream implementations. Private catalogues and engine-bridge evidence must
not be included in an unreviewed public archive.
